identity.promise: Prints occupy remembered places on one quiet table, following separate loop-closed micro-currents; focus lifts one print and returns it without collision, jump, or z-order surprise.
identity.antiMotion: Quiet Drift is not a carousel, shuffled stack, screensaver, loose particle field, or a lower-amplitude copy of Lively Prints. It never remaps an identity to another slot, changes source order, invents a route from wall-clock randomness, or makes source brightness carry attention.
